sources.title: Command R7B Arabic model card
sources.evidence: Exact dated variant: developed by Cohere/Cohere Labs; open weights under CC-BY-NC with acceptable-use terms; approximately 8B total, explicitly split into 7B Transformer and 1B embedding parameters; 128,000-token text-only autoregressive Transformer, trained for Arabic/English instruction following, chat and RAG.

sources.title: Introducing Command R7B Arabic
sources.evidence: Official launch page explicitly dated February 27, 2025 and titled Introducing Command R7B Arabic. Page text accessible in this audit includes headline, date and summary; model details are taken from the model card.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint public repository metadata and chat templates
sources.evidence: Public metadata at revision 2d5440c7cea22410006fb461a1b24c067683da77 names Cohere2ForCausalLM and cohere2. It exposes default, tool_use and rag templates; tool_use serializes function schemas, tool calls, tool_plan and tool results. The raw config.json request returned HTTP 401. Aggregate safetensors metadata was not treated as an independently verified learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Transformers v4.49.0 Cohere2 implementation
sources.evidence: Inspected the official raw file. Cohere2ForCausalLM instantiates Cohere2Model; its decoder layers each instantiate Cohere2MLP, whose gate/up/down linear projections are evaluated densely. There is no expert router in that exact named implementation. Local/global attention matches the checkpoint card.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic: A Small, Enterprise Focused, Multilingual, and Culturally Aware Arabic LLM
sources.evidence: March 18, 2025 first-party technical report identifies Command R7B as the starting checkpoint and describes Arabic SFT/preference tuning, cultural-knowledge and RAG evaluation. Its training experts are merged into a single general model by parameter-wise interpolation, not routed at inference. Its 7B shorthand is qualified by the model card's explicit 8B total breakdown.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere's Models
sources.evidence: Cohere explicitly calls command-a-reasoning-08-2025 its first reasoning model, providing a positive chronology-based classification boundary for the earlier February Arabic release. This does not deny ordinary reasoning or tool planning by older Command models.

sources.title: Reasoning Capabilities
sources.evidence: Defines the native reasoning feature as hybrid enabled/disabled thinking, dedicated thinking content blocks and optional thinking token budgets. This distinguishes the dedicated reasoning-model flag from ordinary problem-solving and tool_plan text.

sources.title: Cohere Releases Arabic-Optimized Command Model!
sources.evidence: February 27, 2025 announcement explicitly describes Command R7B Arabic as an 8-billion-parameter open-weights model with 128,000 context. Its identifier/code mistakenly reference the December base model, so exact checkpoint identity is established through the Arabic card and API metadata instead.

name.note: Exact official model name; dated checkpoint identity is c4ai-command-r7b-arabic-02-2025.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and Cohere Labs; Cohere is the catalog developer.

family.note: Command R7B specialization, explicitly initialized from Command R7B in the technical report; existing family key is appropriate.

release_date.note: Explicit dated first-party launch announcement; exact checkpoint repository was also created that day. The March report date is later.

open_weights.note: Developer calls this an open-weights research release. Download requires acceptance of noncommercial terms; open weights does not mean unrestricted use.

license.note: Repository metadata names cc-by-nc-4.0; model card additionally requires Cohere Labs acceptable-use terms.

parameters_b.note: Nominal approximate complete total: the exact card explicitly says ~8B, comprising 7B Transformer plus 1B embedding parameters. Do not mistake the R7B name or report shorthand for the complete total. No exact learned count is claimed from aggregate safetensors metadata.

active_parameters_b.note: Reviewed card and subsequent technical report do not separately define or quantify per-token active parameters. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total into this field.

architecture.note: Exact checkpoint config.architectures maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM; the official implementation uses a dense MLP in every decoder layer. The report's expert merging is weight interpolation during training, not inference-time MoE routing.

context_window.note: Card explicitly gives 128,000 tokens, resolving its abbreviated 128K label.

modalities.note: Exact model card explicitly states input text only and output text only.

reasoning.note: Interpreted as dedicated native reasoning mode, not general reasoning ability. Cohere explicitly labels the later August 2025 Command A Reasoning its first reasoning model. The exact Arabic checkpoint template instead represents its thinking spans as tool_plan associated with tool calls. This is a chronology-and-protocol inference from positive evidence, not an inference from missing model-card prose.

tool_call.note: Exact released checkpoint includes a native tool_use template with function schemas, structured tool calls and tool-result turns; not merely a general prompting claim.

description.value: Open Command R model optimized for Arabic enterprise chat, RAG, and cultural knowledge
description.note: Supported by the exact card and report. Open denotes open weights with noncommercial restrictions, clarified in license/notes.

patch.notes: Approximately 8B total parameters: 7B Transformer parameters plus 1B embedding parameters, per the developer model card. Active parameters are not separately reported. Open weights require CC-BY-NC-4.0 and Cohere Labs acceptable-use terms. The reasoning flag describes a dedicated reasoning mode; native tool planning remains supported.

summary: Fill nominal approximately 8B complete parameters, CC-BY-NC-4.0 license and dense architecture from exact checkpoint primary evidence. Keep active parameters undisclosed; do not derive an exact learned count from aggregate storage metadata. Confirm release date, text-only 128k context, native tool calling and dedicated reasoning=false using the explicitly later first reasoning model plus this checkpoint's tool-plan protocol. Record the launch changelog's erroneous December identifier instead of transferring that identifier.
